_note: Homographs: one English string that is genuinely two different words. Each key is '<collection> / <entry> :: <field>' as `terms` prints it, and the value says why the disagreement is correct. Keep this list short -- every entry is a signal switched off.
daggerheart.subclasses / Lunar Phases ::: A lunar phase (満月), not the UI's 'Full' restore (完全).
daggerheart.subclasses / Perfect Recall: Recalling a card from the vault (リコール, as the card UI calls it), not the Knowledge trait's verb (想起する).
en:Guardian: An adversary's experience 守護者 ('one who guards'), which is not the Guardian class (ガーディアン).
daggerheart.adversaries / Sprite :: name: The adversary species スプライト, not the generic word for a fey: the Forest Sprites card summons 妖精, which is also what the Redcaps are called.
daggerheart.adversaries / Vault Guardian: Taking aim at a target (狙いを定める), not the Sigil of Retribution's heraldic marking (紋章を刻む).
daggerheart.weapons / Grappler :: name: The grappling-hook device 鉤縄, not the Masque Muerte Experience of the same name, which is the grappling skill 組み技.
daggerheart.consumables / Chimeric Saliv: Smearing a salve or venom onto something (塗る), not the environment packs' button that applies an active effect (適用).
